lines: Priyanka Manish Sharma, Promoter Group, holds 57,000 shares and is not selling in the offer.
Retained shares are valued at up to ₹7.71 crore (estimate, valued at offer price), unlocked since 9 Sep 2026.
Their retained stake is locked in, so the value may rise later with the offer price.
Shares are not cash; the ₹7.71 crore figure is an estimate at offer price.
